heard: Voyager 1 would need 74,000 years to reach our nearest neighboring star. We often imagine Proxima Centauri is right next door at just 4.2 light years away. This red dwarf hides a roughly Earth-sized world orbiting within its habitable zone. Proxima Centauri B completes its year in 11.2 days, making it a tempting destination. There is even a candidate second world, Proxima Centauri C, orbiting much further out. To explore beyond our sun, NASA sent Voyager 1 past Jupiter and Saturn carrying the golden record. Yet human technology cannot shrink the terrifying vastness of interstellar space, even traveling 17 kilometers per second since 1977, crossing four light years to reach our nearest planet means.
